concerns.text: FR-016 is not anchored to any user story. It reads “System MUST perform a sensitivity analysis … (Backs SC‑006)” but no story (US‑1, US‑2, or US‑3) mentions a sensitivity‑analysis step, leaving the requirement orphaned.

SC-005 (Compute feasibility) does not reference a specific user story. The criterion spans the whole pipeline, but the specification requires each success criterion to be tied to a story; currently no story explicitly claims the 6‑hour / 6 GB resource bound.

SC-006 (Threshold justification) is also unanchored. It expects a sensitivity analysis that is not linked to any story, and the only place such an analysis is mentioned is FR‑016, which itself lacks a story reference.

User Story 3 (Demographic Stratification and Visualization) has no associated success criteria. Without SCs, there is no measurable target for the stratification/visualization deliverable, violating the requirement that every story be backed by at least one SC.
